verdict.rationale: SigNoz ships an official MCP server that gives AI agents natural-language access to query metrics, traces, logs, alerts and dashboards. It also publishes Agent Skills that let assistants create and modify dashboards and manage alerts, plus documented use cases such as dashboard creation from natural language, so the product itself covers both querying and operating. Missing for 10: a native in-app natural-language assistant (all access runs through external AI clients such as Claude or Cursor), and independent or hands-on corroboration that natural-language operation works reliably.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: Connect Claude, Cursor, Copilot, and other AI agents to SigNoz via MCP for natural language access to metrics, logs, traces, and alerts.
Query metrics, traces, logs, alerts, and dashboards through natural language.
